infoPlist.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Save and open documents in your Documents folder.

read.description: Read files and folders, and the base paths.

write.description: Create, change, move and remove files and folders.

scope.description: Which files a call may touch. Both fields are optional globs.

fields.base: base directory: data, cache, documents or temp (glob)
fields.path: path relative to the base, "/" separated; * stays in a folder, ** crosses folders, "dir/**" includes dir itself; in allow no wildcard matches a name starting with "." (write ".config/**"), in deny they do
